## Quick start

Run from the dx_app root after `./install.sh` and `./build.sh`.

```bash
# from the dx_app root
./setup_sample_models.sh --models beit-b-p16_384x384
```

**Python**

```bash
python src/python_example/image_classification/beit/beit-b-p16_384x384/beit-b-p16_384x384_sync.py \
  --model assets/models/beit-b-p16_384x384.dxnn \
  --image sample/img/sample_dog.jpg
```

**C++**

```bash
./build.sh --target beit-b-p16_384x384_sync   # once
./bin/beit-b-p16_384x384_sync \
  -m assets/models/beit-b-p16_384x384.dxnn \
  -i sample/img/sample_dog.jpg
```
